description: This file defines the abstract class 'db_easy_mesh_t' which specifies an interface for managing mesh database tables, including initialization, synchronization, configuration, and CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) operations related to a mesh network database. The class contains pure virtual functions, indicating it is meant to be extended by concrete implementations.

classes.name: db_easy_mesh_t
classes.description: An abstract class providing an interface for mesh database management, including methods for table initialization, synchronization, configuration, and CRUD operations.

methods.name: init_columns
methods.description: Pure virtual function to initialize database columns.

methods.name: sync_db
methods.description: Pure virtual function to synchronize the database with a given client and context.

methods.name: update_db
methods.description: Pure virtual function to update the database with a specified operation and data.

methods.name: search_db
methods.description: Pure virtual function to search the database with a key.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Pure virtual function to compare two database mesh objects.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Pure virtual function to set configuration from a JSON object.

methods.name: get_config
methods.description: Pure virtual function to retrieve configuration into a JSON object.

methods.name: get_column_format
methods.description: Returns string representing column format for a given database format type and position.

methods.name: get_strings_by_token
methods.description: Extracts substrings from a parent string based on a token.

methods.name: create_table
methods.description: Creates a database table using the provided database client.

methods.name: load_table
methods.description: Loads and initializes a table from the database.

methods.name: sync_table
methods.description: Synchronizes the in-memory table with the database.

methods.name: delete_table
methods.description: Deletes the table from the database.

methods.name: is_table_empty
methods.description: Checks if the database table is empty.

methods.name: entry_exists_in_table
methods.description: Checks if a specific entry exists in the table.

methods.name: insert_row
methods.description: Inserts a new row into the database.

methods.name: update_row
methods.description: Updates a row in the database.

methods.name: compare_row
methods.description: Compares a row in the database.

methods.name: delete_row
methods.description: Deletes a row from the database.

methods.name: db_easy_mesh_t
methods.description: Constructor for the abstract mesh database class.

methods.name: ~db_easy_mesh_t
methods.description: Destructor for the class.
